Lando Norris drove for McLaren throughout the 2021 Formula 1 season, contesting 22 rounds [S1].

In summary, Norris's documented 2021 campaign featured four podium finishes (Emilia Romagna P3, Monaco P3, Austria P3, and Italy P2) and one non-classified-podium retirement-affected round at Hungary (Collision, P15) [S1].
